subject: NovumCorp — demo scheduling & IT availability coordination
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-12T13:12:00Z
Subject: NovumCorp — demo scheduling & IT availability coordination

Hi Priya —

Thanks for signing up for a self-serve trial of Redwood. I’m Connor (SDR) — looping in Jasmine (AE) and Marcus (SE) so we can align a short walkthrough that includes your security/IT questions.

Quick ask: could you share 2× 60–75 minute windows in the next week that work for your team (please include timezone)? We typically structure the call as: 15 min intro + 35 min product demo (AE+SE) + 15–25 min IT/security Q&A. If you prefer a shorter session focused on security first, we can adapt.

Also, if you have an internal checklist or specific artifacts (SOC 2, data flow diagrams, retention rules) please attach them — Marcus will review ahead of time.

I’ve included a Calendly link if you want to pick a slot directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/novum-demo

Attachments: redwood-demo-brief.pdf (demo agenda & prep)

—
Connor O'Brien
SDR, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novumcorp.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Reed <daniel.reed@novumcorp.com>, ops@novumcorp.com
Date: 2027-07-12T14:04:00Z
Subject: Re: NovumCorp — demo scheduling & IT availability coordination

Thanks Connor —

We’re interested in seeing the platform with an emphasis on security and data handling. Our security team prefers a time when both the AE & SE can cover architecture and isolation controls. Available windows (BST):
- Tue 2027-07-13: 09:30–11:00 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed 2027-07-14: 13:00–15:00

Please note: our on-call IT lead will be remote on Tue afternoon and in-office Wed morning.

I’m attaching our IT contact matrix and a short checklist of required artifacts. Also, before any screening call we ask SEs to confirm they can share details on: encryption in transit/at rest, VPC options, audit logs retention, and how private deployments handle KMS.

Attachments: Novum_IT_Contacts.xlsx, Novum_IT_Checklist.pdf

Best,
Priya Sharma
Head of IT Security — NovumCorp
priya.sharma@novumcorp.com

Connor — once Marcus confirms, I’ll send a calendar invitation with a short agenda and who’s expected from Novum.

Prefer Tue 2027-07-13 14:00 BST as proposed — that keeps the on-call IT lead on the line. I’ll also ask for a short pre-read from Priya (network diagram or questions) so I can tailor the deep-dive.

I’ll draft the invite and include a Teams/Zoom link.

Join: Zoom (link included in calendar invite)
